body: A seed packet leaked into this mailbox. The paper at the bottom is gritty. The letters above it stayed clean.
title: Seed bag and newspaper

body: The opened packet is bound with a rubber band. A few dark kernels remain. A second unopened packet is tucked behind it.
title: Corn seed and seed bag

body: A sack strip and a feed scoop were pushed in here together. The scoop still has the same dark grains that are stuck to the strip.
title: Seed bag and spoon

body: These seeds came back with blackened tips. The packet mailed out beside them is still sealed.
title: Carrot seed and corn seed

body: Corn tied to the map with twine. Two circles in pencil, one crossed. The twine still smells like field chemicals.
title: Map, twine and corn

body: I found an empty jar with green residue caked inside. A carrot seed packet is taped across the top. It was stored in the chemical shed behind the barn.
title: Empty jar and seed

body: A newspaper is wrapped around a withered tomato vine. Its leaves are freckled where field dust collected.
title: Newspaper and tomato

body: Duct tape stuck to the seed bag corner. Two arrows drawn on it pointed somewhere else. Someone was tracking something through the fields.
title: Duct tape and seed bag

body: The seed bag is tied shut with rope. The knot looks professional. Dark residue stains the outside. Nothing grew where it spilled.
title: Seed bag and rope

body: One packet of corn is damp and swollen. Another was packed dry beside it. Someone left both here for collection.
title: Corn seed and empty jar
